pages.review: IMPORTANT 前言全文及准确型号。
12条安全事项、14条操作事项；原双栏及 Any tampering 开始的右栏续文；风险横条、WARNING、子项短横线。
DANGER 全文、维护段落、4个信号词原警示图标、左右两组安全图标及说明。
FCC 原左栏 opening/NOTE、右栏 If this equipment；3个装箱物品和TIP。
产品原图及所有端口标注/参数；下方AC总输出局部图保持右对齐。
LCD原图1–22；图例1–8全部状态与条件。
图例9–22；单圈序号；19对应高低温共用号格；On/Blink/Off全文。
原POWER/AC绘图；2小时、12小时、3W条件；右侧原生待机说明气泡和图内NOTE；AC图内先决条件。
原DC/USB绘图及图内先决条件、原生说明/CAUTION；12V而非24V；节能默认、25W、12小时、3秒和App条件。
原节能按键图；完整NOTE/WARNING；6行LCD操作表2分钟/2小时/3W；原按键和时钟图的2行操作表。
UPS的20ms、1440W、旁路条件；灰底图内先决条件；完整WARNING含3类关键设备和起搏器；4条CAUTION含级联；充电优先级和温度降额1000W。
原AC/单太阳能板/连接器绘图；AC警告；2个DC8020和每口最多2块板的说明。
太阳能开路电压16–60V；每口最多2块板；双口电压、板数、车充与太阳能同时使用限制；车充12V而非24V及图内原说明。
原4幅清洁绘图；原生4个圆号灰底卡片，桌面2×2、手机顺序排列；冲洗、干燥及回装全部条件。
储存1/3/12个月、温湿度和充放电周期；F0–F3分格且共用Restart措施；F4–F9全文，包括F6五步/30cm/45°C，F7太阳能条件/60V。
3+2年保修；全部5组条款、除外事项及解释权。
本型号原App商店/QR/加设备/按键图；2.1、2.2全文；标题1/2的圆点和2小时NOTE。
2.3–2.5全文和NOTE；原1500Ultra界面图；解绑及4.1–4.3 Wi-Fi/Bluetooth 2小时/10秒条件；标题3/4圆点。
公司、地址、电话、邮箱、网址原文；本次原PDF裁剪的3个联系图标和原QR；原生联系框。

all_inherited_declarations.old_declaration: Outlined PDF: original.pdf has no text layer; every English line is a manual transcription from 220-400 dpi renders, kept as printed (source/intake.py names the physical page of each block).
all_inherited_declarations.disposition: Verified current source PDF and full body transcription.

all_inherited_declarations.old_declaration: Shared Manual IR: content.json is replayed through the shared flow renderer and shared components. No package class, inline style or plain table (prepared-document shared-style gate).
all_inherited_declarations.disposition: Native components retained; corrective native geometry is needed for original source columns/cells, not a historical text exception.

all_inherited_declarations.old_declaration: Print weights: bold print runs stay strong; headings keep print case. Printed bullet and number marks become lists; hollow-bullet items nest under their item. Subscripts (V_oc, LiFePO4) stay subscript.
all_inherited_declarations.disposition: Bold/subscripts retained; native dashed subitems, single circled LCDnumbers andfilledcleaningnumbercircles restored.

all_inherited_declarations.old_declaration: Line ends inside a paragraph are wraps; the print's explicit line breaks inside one block stay line breaks.
all_inherited_declarations.disposition: Native explicitDCinputconditionbreak andtablemergedcells restored; prose wraps remainresponsive.

all_inherited_declarations.old_declaration: Figures are source panels cropped just inside the print's panel frame (the decorative frame is drawn by the shared theme); words drawn in the art stay in the art and the alt text carries printed sentences. Notes and cautions the print boxes inside a panel are shared callout strips under the figure; grey text bubbles and pills inside a panel are shared text panels and their vector objects are left out of the render.
all_inherited_declarations.disposition: REPAIRED: formerly detached panelcopy restored within sourceframes; native right-side standbybubble andcarcaption restore sourceposition; allsourceartunchanged.

all_inherited_declarations.old_declaration: LCD glyphs reuse the same-generation JE-1500D US or the JE-1500C TW glyph when it passes the fixed comparison against this print; the others are this print's native vector paths.
all_inherited_declarations.disposition: Each reused glyph visually checked against current p8–9; correctnumber/icon/meaning mapping retained.

all_inherited_declarations.old_declaration: Cover (p1) and table of contents (p3) are not Web content; the back cover (p22) becomes the closing contact section without its phone/mail/web pictograms.
all_inherited_declarations.disposition: REPAIRED: p22original phone/mail/webpictograms restored; frontcover/paperTOCexcluded byexplicituser instruction.
